description.value: Backcountry Brewing is a craft brewery and tasting room founded in 2017 by five owner-operators in Squamish, winning 'Rookie of the Year' at the BC Beer Awards in its debut year. The 70s ski cabin-inspired taproom pours from a 20-tap tower alongside cider, wine, and non-alcoholic options, with a scratch kitchen turning out rotating pizzas, seasonal salads, and snacks using local organic ingredients. Set in a mountain town renowned for cycling and outdoor adventure, it bills itself as an après-adventure destination, complete with covered bike parking and map-top tables for planning your next route.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website explicitly confirms covered bike parking in the FAQs: 'Dogs may be tied up under our covered bike parking in front of the taproom with ample shade and water dishes available.' Takeout is confirmed via 'We offer our beer to-go in 473ml can 4-packs and singles' and the retail store selling canned beer. Vegan/dairy-free food options are confirmed in the FAQs, and the phone number and address on the website match the OSM record exactly.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active craft brewery and tasting room in Squamish with confirmed covered bike parking, vegan food options, and takeout — a clear fit for cycling tourists seeking an après-ride stop in a major BC mountain biking hub.

Bike parking or bike visibility.detail: Covered bike parking at the front of the taproom implies a bike rack; FAQs reference dogs being tied up there alongside water dishes

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: FAQs confirm: 'We do have vegan and dairy-free options.' Gluten-free food experience described as limited but accommodated where possible. No gluten-free beer offered due to shared equipment

Covered bike parking.detail: FAQs explicitly state 'covered bike parking in front of the taproom.'

wow_evidence: covered bike parking... map-top tables for planning your next route... 'Rookie of the Year' at the BC Beer Awards
